registers.name: CONTROL
registers.description: Host control register. Writing this register updates host-visible enable and clear-fault control fields and may also be used as a configuration-strobe trigger when combined with the configuration window.

fields.name: ENABLE
fields.description: Controller enable. Maps to host_cfg_enable. When 0, the controller enters safe fallback mode and act_valid is deasserted.

fields.name: CLEAR_FAULT
fields.description: Host clear-fault request. Clears sticky_fault only when no active fault condition persists.

registers.name: MODE
registers.description: Operating mode selection register. Two-bit mode value used both for request packing and host-visible control state.

fields.name: MODE_SEL
fields.description: Operating mode select. Maps to host_cfg_mode and current_mode reporting.

registers.name: VELOCITY_L
registers.description: Operating velocity input, low byte.

registers.name: VELOCITY_H
registers.description: Operating velocity input, high byte.

registers.name: TIMEOUT_THRESHOLD_L
registers.description: Freshness timeout threshold in cycles, low byte.

registers.name: TIMEOUT_THRESHOLD_H
registers.description: Freshness timeout threshold in cycles, high byte.

registers.name: MIN_CMD_L
registers.description: Minimum actuator command clamp, low byte.

registers.name: MIN_CMD_H
registers.description: Minimum actuator command clamp, high byte.

registers.name: MAX_CMD_L
registers.description: Maximum actuator command clamp, low byte.

registers.name: MAX_CMD_H
registers.description: Maximum actuator command clamp, high byte.

registers.name: SLEW_LIMIT_L
registers.description: Maximum per-update actuator slew limit, low byte.

registers.name: SLEW_LIMIT_H
registers.description: Maximum per-update actuator slew limit, high byte.

registers.name: REQ_SEQ_L
registers.description: Request sequence number, low byte.

registers.name: REQ_SEQ_H
registers.description: Request sequence number, high byte.

registers.name: GEOMETRY_HANDLE_L

registers.name: GEOMETRY_HANDLE_H

registers.name: STATUS
registers.description: Compact status register. Reports controller state, fault indication, and safety supervision summary.

fields.name: STATUS[1:0]
fields.description: Compact state encoding. Host-readable supervisory state summary.

registers.name: STICKY_FAULT
registers.description: Sticky fault bit.

fields.name: STICKY_FAULT
fields.description: Host-visible sticky fault flag. Remains set until cleared under safe conditions.

registers.name: LAST_ACCEPTED_SEQ_L

fields.name: LAST_ACCEPTED_SEQ[7:0]

registers.name: LAST_ACCEPTED_SEQ_H
registers.description: Last accepted request sequence number, high byte.

fields.name: LAST_ACCEPTED_SEQ[15:8]
fields.description: High byte of last accepted sequence number.

fields.name: LAST_VALID_RESP_AGE[7:0]

fields.name: LAST_VALID_RESP_AGE[15:8]

registers.name: CURRENT_MODE

sources.name: FAULT_IRQ
sources.description: Optional software-visible interrupt source asserted when sticky fault becomes set due to stale, mismatched, malformed, invalid, or timed-out response conditions.

sources.name: TIMEOUT_IRQ
sources.description: Optional software-visible interrupt source asserted when the freshness monitor detects timeout_threshold expiration for the outstanding request.

init_sequence: Deassert enable and clear_fault; write min_cmd, max_cmd, slew_limit, timeout_threshold, geometry_handle, flow_summary, velocity, and req_seq fields to establish a valid operating configuration.
Write MODE to select the desired operating mode.
Assert ENABLE and then issue a configuration strobe through CONTROL with host_cfg_valid behavior implied by the register write transaction model.
Poll STATUS, STICKY_FAULT, and CURRENT_MODE to confirm controller enters the intended non-fallback state.
polling_sequence: Poll STATUS for fault and state changes.
Poll STICKY_FAULT and clear it only after verifying the unsafe condition is no longer active.
Poll LAST_ACCEPTED_SEQ and LAST_VALID_RESP_AGE to correlate response freshness.
Poll ACT_VALID, ACT_MODE, and ACT_CMD to observe the registered actuator output state.
Poll RESP_TIMEOUT and RESP_SEQ registers if software wants to diagnose transport/response issues.
irq_sequence: On FAULT_IRQ or TIMEOUT_IRQ, stop issuing new requests, read STATUS and STICKY_FAULT, and place the broader system in conservative mode.
If the fault source clears, write CLEAR_FAULT only after confirming no active fault persists.
Resume normal operation only after sticky fault clears, status returns to safe non-faulted operation, and a new request configuration is accepted.

consistency_notes: All assumptions remain compatible with DIGITAL_SPEC_JSON.
The register map is custom and byte-addressed, consistent with the compact register-file preference and the absence of an implied AXI/APB requirement.
No hierarchy, ports, or filenames are invented beyond the DIGITAL_SPEC_JSON top-level design.
Wide fields are split across 8-bit registers; no register exceeds the 8-bit data bus width.
Software-visible mirrors of ready/valid and parsed response fields are read-only observation registers only and do not alter the required top-level RTL port contract.
